record missing: LIBRARY-APPLY-RECORD-MISSING: The selected record is not in the stored library. Refresh the library list, open the library again and choose a record it holds.
source rejected: LIBRARY-APPLY-SOURCE-REJECTED: The record is marked rejected, so its data is not applied. Choose a different record, or re-import the library with reviewed source dispositions.
magnitude invalid: LIBRARY-APPLY-MAGNITUDE-INVALID: Slot p.elastic_modulus has the magnitude "2e11x", which is not a finite number. Correct the value in the library and re-import it, or choose a different record.
unit unresolved: LIBRARY-APPLY-UNIT-UNRESOLVED: Slot p.elastic_modulus names unit "unit.MPa", which is not a unit of the DEC-018 catalog. Use a catalog unit id (for example unit:pascal) in the library and re-import it.
ambiguous source: LIBRARY-APPLY-AMBIGUOUS-SOURCE: The record holds more than one copyable elastic_modulus, so the source is ambiguous. Keep one elastic_modulus in the record and re-import the library, or choose a different record.
E missing: LIBRARY-APPLY-MEMBER-MISSING: The record has no copyable elastic_modulus (E). Choose a record that provides E, or add E to this record and re-import the library.
ν blocked (E/ν): LIBRARY-APPLY-MEMBER-BLOCKED: The record stores ν but it cannot be copied (p.poisson_ratio.q (excluded: quarantined)). Fix or re-import the record's ν, or choose a different record.
ν missing (E/ν): LIBRARY-APPLY-MEMBER-MISSING: E/ν mode needs poisson_ratio (ν), and the record has none. Choose E/G mode if the record provides G, or choose a record that provides ν.
ν unit: LIBRARY-APPLY-UNIT-UNRESOLVED: Slot p.poisson_ratio gives ν in unit Pa; ν must carry unit 1 (unit:one). Correct the unit in the library and re-import it, or choose a different record.
G blocked (E/ν): LIBRARY-APPLY-MEMBER-BLOCKED: The record stores G but it cannot be copied (p.shear_modulus.hot (temperature-referenced; library temperature points carry no temperature value)), and G is never derived when the record stores one. Fix or re-import the record's G, or choose a different record.
ν provided (E/G): LIBRARY-APPLY-NU-NOT-DISCARDED: The record provides ν (slot p.poisson_ratio), and E/G mode would discard it. Choose E/ν mode.
ν blocked (E/G): LIBRARY-APPLY-NU-NOT-DISCARDED: The record stores ν but it cannot be copied (p.poisson_ratio.q (excluded: quarantined)), and ν is never discarded. Fix or re-import the record's ν, or choose a different record.
G blocked (E/G): LIBRARY-APPLY-MEMBER-BLOCKED: The record stores G but it cannot be copied (p.shear_modulus.hot (temperature-referenced; library temperature points carry no temperature value)). Fix or re-import the record's G, or choose a different record.
G missing (E/G): LIBRARY-APPLY-MEMBER-MISSING: E/G mode needs shear_modulus (G), and the record has none. Choose E/ν mode if the record provides ν, or choose a record that provides G.
target ν (E/G apply): LIBRARY-APPLY-NU-NOT-DISCARDED: This material already has poisson_ratio (ν = 0.3). Apply a record that provides ν in E/ν mode, or insert this record as a new material in E/G mode.
retained quarantined: LIBRARY-APPLY-RETAINED-QUARANTINED: The entity keeps thermal_expansion_coefficient from a previous source marked quarantined, so they cannot be combined with this record. Choose "replace all values" to remove them, or have the previous source reviewed and update the entity's Source review, then apply.
material target missing: LIBRARY-APPLY-TARGET-MISSING: Material material:absent is not in the model. Select a material in the model and prepare the apply again.
id invalid: LIBRARY-APPLY-ID-INVALID: "9bad" is not a valid model id. Enter an id that starts with a letter and uses only letters, digits, _ . : or -.
id taken: LIBRARY-APPLY-ID-INVALID: material:invented-carbon-steel is already used in the model. Enter an id the model does not use yet.
section type: LIBRARY-APPLY-SECTION-TYPE: Only pipe sections apply, and this record is rigid. Choose a record whose section_type is pipe.
section member missing: LIBRARY-APPLY-MEMBER-MISSING: A new section needs wall_thickness, and the record has no copyable value for it. Choose a record that provides it, or apply this record to an existing section instead.
section nothing copied: LIBRARY-APPLY-NOTHING-COPIED: The record has no copyable outside_diameter or wall_thickness, so nothing would change. Choose a record that provides them, or add them to this record and re-import the library.
section replace all: LIBRARY-APPLY-REQUIRED-MEMBER: A pipe section requires properties.wall_thickness, and the record does not supply it, so "replace all values" cannot remove it. Choose "keep them", or a record that supplies both dimensions.
section target missing: LIBRARY-APPLY-TARGET-MISSING: Section section:absent is not in the model. Select a section in the model and prepare the apply again.
component kind: LIBRARY-APPLY-KIND-MISMATCH: A valve record does not apply to a bend component. Choose a bend record, or select a valve component.
component no values: LIBRARY-APPLY-KIND-MISMATCH: A terminal component takes no library values. Select a component of kind bend, elbow, branch, tee, branch_connection, reducer, valve, flange, rigid, specialty or expansion_joint whose kind matches the record's component_type (terminal), or choose a record of one of those kinds.
component nothing copied: LIBRARY-APPLY-NOTHING-COPIED: The record supplies no value this component can take, so nothing would change. Choose a record that provides a value from the copy table for this component, or add one to this record and re-import the library.
component required: LIBRARY-APPLY-REQUIRED-MEMBER: modifiers.flexibility_factor_user_value is required for a bend, and the record does not supply it, so it is not removed. Choose "keep them", or a record that supplies modifiers.flexibility_factor_user_value.
component unsourced: LIBRARY-APPLY-RETAINED-UNSOURCED: geometry.rigid_body_length, geometry.end_a_size, geometry.end_b_size, geometry.center_of_gravity would keep values that have no source reference. Enter the group's source reference on the component first, then apply again.
component target missing: LIBRARY-APPLY-TARGET-MISSING: Component component:absent is not in the model. Select a component in the model and prepare the apply again.
hanger library rejected: LIBRARY-APPLY-SOURCE-REJECTED: The hanger library is marked rejected, so its data is not applied. Choose a different record, or re-import the library with reviewed source dispositions.
unit unresolved (ν): LIBRARY-APPLY-UNIT-UNRESOLVED: Slot p.poisson_ratio names unit "unit.one", which is not a unit of the DEC-018 catalog. Use a catalog unit id (for example unit:one) in the library and re-import it.
unit unresolved (α): LIBRARY-APPLY-UNIT-UNRESOLVED: Slot p.thermal_expansion_coefficient names unit "unit.per_C", which is not a unit of the DEC-018 catalog. Use a catalog unit id (for example unit:per_degree_celsius) in the library and re-import it.
retained quarantined (section): LIBRARY-APPLY-RETAINED-QUARANTINED: The entity keeps properties.wall_thickness from a previous source marked quarantined, so they cannot be combined with this record. Have the previous source reviewed and update the entity's Source review in its Provenance record section, then apply.
hanger quantity: LIBRARY-APPLY-SOURCE-REJECTED: A hanger quantity in this record is marked quarantined, so the record is not applied. Choose a different record, or re-import the library with reviewed source dispositions.
unreadable record disposition: MODEL-DISPOSITION-RECORD-MALFORMED: Record mat.invented.steel of the material library matlib.invented.private holds review_status as an array or an object, so its disposition cannot be read and the record is not applied. Open the library in the Library Manager, write each redistribution_status and review_status as text and each provenance as an object, and save it to the local store again, or choose a different library.
unreadable library disposition: MODEL-DISPOSITION-RECORD-MALFORMED: The library metadata of the material library matlib.invented.private holds provenance as an array or an object, so its disposition cannot be read and record mat.invented.steel is not applied. Open the library in the Library Manager, write each redistribution_status and review_status as text and each provenance as an object, and save it to the local store again, or choose a different library.
unreadable hanger disposition: MODEL-DISPOSITION-RECORD-MALFORMED: Record h1 of the hanger library h holds review_status as an array or an object, so its disposition cannot be read and the record is not applied. Open the library in the Library Manager, write each redistribution_status and review_status as text and each provenance as an object, and save it to the local store again, or choose a different library.
